senses.sense_definition: To come closer to something in space or time.

examples.text: The ship <w>nears</w> the land after a long voyage across the ocean.

examples.text: As we <w>neared</w> the city center, the traffic became much heavier.

target_lang_translations.ru: Когда мы <w>приближались</w> к центру города, движение стало намного интенсивнее.

target_lang_translations.de: Als wir uns dem Stadtzentrum <w>näherten</w>, wurde der Verkehr viel dichter.
target_lang_translations.fr: Alors que nous <w>approchions</w> du centre-ville, la circulation est devenue beaucoup plus dense.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当我们<w>接近</w>市中心时，交通变得拥堵多了。

senses.sense_definition: The left side of a horse or a team of horses.

examples.text: In equestrian terminology, the left is always referred to as the <w>near</w>.

target_lang_translations.ru: В терминологии верховой езды левая сторона всегда называется <w>левой</w>.

target_lang_translations.fr: Dans la terminologie équestre, la gauche est toujours appelée le <w>côté gauche</w>.
target_lang_translations.it: Nella terminologia equestre, la sinistra viene sempre definita come il lato <w>sinistro</w>.

examples.text: The groom stood by the <w>near</w> to adjust the saddle.

target_lang_translations.pl: Stajenny stanął po <w>lewej stronie</w>, aby poprawić siodło.
target_lang_translations.de: Der Bräutigam stand an der <w>linken Seite</w>, um den Sattel anzupassen.

target_lang_translations.tr: Seyis, eyeri düzeltmek için atın <w>sol tarafında</w> durdu.
